notes: Same code, rules, seeds, windows and choice rules on both sides; only the periods 1 / 2 bars differ (sweep = Astral/Polygon aggregated USD spot; binance = Binance USDT-M futures, research/binance_data/build.py). Period 3 of C is the unchanged Binance pre2021 cache in both runs, so its numbers are identical.

Windows: the Binance series start 2021-01-01, the sweep ones 2021-05-30, so warm-ups end before 2021-08-01 on both for 5m..4h (identical window starts). For 1d (B only) the sweep IS window starts 2021-12-17 on coins whose sweep series starts 2021-05-30 (200-bar warm-up), the Binance one on 2021-08-01. The sweep series end ~2026-09-29 08:00-09:35 UTC, the Binance ones 2026-09-29 23:55, so the cf window has a few more bars on Binance. Binance halts are gaps (dropped zero-volume bars).

Committed research/strategy_profiles/out/profiles.json (and cards.json / PROFILES.md) carry DOGE account columns from the pre-DOGE-fix accounts (research/paper_rules/out/before_doge_fix/accounts.csv): profiles.py ran at 16:14, before rules_bt rewrote out/accounts.csv at 16:15. Everything else in it reproduces exactly. The originals were not overwritten; this comparison's A account columns are read straight from the two accounts.csv files.

A: 'hold_verdict' = report.hold_verdict on the 16-bar hold-more ROE (|t| >= 2 and sign); cells with no signals count as insufficient_data. B: PREREG_RULES.md rule applied by rules_bt.choose unchanged. C: robustness re-run, not the pre-registered result (PREREG_ENTRY.md fixes the sweep data).

Funding: the research charges 0.0001 per 8h to both sides; the ROE effect figures are first-order (40 x rate x hold / 8) with the typical hold = median over the 36 strategies of the Binance profiles' median hold per timeframe; the side-mix figure assumes the funding sign is independent of the trade side.

funding.research_assumption: both sides pay 0.0001 per 8h, accrued per bar (rules_bt.FUNDING_8H)
funding.method: per 8h = sum(rate) / (hours covered / 8), hours covered = sum of each event's funding interval (SOLUSDT has 2 h / 4 h intervals in places); funding files end 2026-08-31 16:00 (monthly archive), so the research window stops there. Real funding is signed: a long pays +rate, a short receives it. ROE effect at 40x for a hold of h hours = 40 x rate_per_8h x h / 8 (expected value over where the entry falls between funding times).
